game_title: Duplicate Sweep – Fallen Statue Garden Rush
game_concept: A speed quiz set in Eldritch Ruins – Fallen Statue Garden, a garden of fallen statues: the spirit seeker must handle stone sentinels while practicing lists. Core idea – Duplicate Sweep: Remove repeated items from a list of moon crystals while keeping the order.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Fallen Statue Garden: a garden of fallen statues
core_gameplay_loop: In Fallen Statue Garden, repeat each round: Remove repeated items from a list of moon crystals while keeping the order. Each round, a new moon crystals challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the clean_list value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 260 points of moon crystals by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 260, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 5 (applied tier): Duplicate Sweep
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
